title: Shapes and Numbers Song (Tiny Sparks original)

lines.text: Count the sides, count the sides,
shapes have numbers, yes it's true!
Count the corners, one by one,
shapes and numbers, so much fun!
A triangle has three straight sides,
three little corners side by side.
Let's count the sides, one, two, and three,
so a triangle has three!
A square has four sides, all the same,
four little corners like a frame.
Let's count the sides, one, two, three, four,
so a square has four, yes four!
Count the sides, count the sides,
shapes have numbers, yes it's true!
Count the corners, one by one,
shapes and numbers, so much fun!
A pentagon has five sides, look!
Like a little house in a book.
Count the sides, one, two, three, four, five,
so a pentagon has five!
A hexagon has six sides too,
busy bees build them, yes it's true!
Count them, one, two, three, four, five, six,
so a hexagon has six!
Count the sides, count the sides,
shapes have numbers, yes it's true!
Count the corners, one by one,
shapes and numbers, so much fun!
A circle rolls around and round,
it has no sides, no corners found.
Let's count the corners, there are none,
the circle has zero, fun!
Count the sides, count the sides,
shapes have numbers, yes it's true!
Count the corners, one by one,
shapes and numbers, so much fun!
How many sides on a square?
Four!
How many sides, triangle?
Three!
How many sides, hexagon?
Six!
How many sides on a circle?
Zero!
Make a triangle with your hands,
now draw a square up in the air,
spin around just like a circle,
jump like a star, one, two, three!
Let's count the sides slowly!
Triangle sides
Three!
Square has four sides
Four!
Count the sides, count the sides,
shapes have numbers, yes it's true!
Count the corners, one by one,
shapes and numbers, so much fun!
